text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I passed by the cafeteria,
some kind of event was taking place—

text_block_list.name: MC Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
All right, folks! Sponsored by the Tracen Academy Cafeteria Committee,
it's the Cooking Contest! Let's introduce our contenders!

text_block_list.name: MC Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
A fortune-boosting method combining feng shui and cooking!
Can they pull it off?! Team Copano Rickey!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickey☆ Lucky☆
Happy Cooking~!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best~♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Nice to meet you all.

text_block_list.name: MC Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
And their opponents, fighting their way to the top
with speedy prep and surprising deliciousness—Team Transcend!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Time-saving recipes are pure justice, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely show everyone
that Funabashi's ingredients are second to none...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. This is gonna be a piece of cake.
Don't you dare underestimate me, punk!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see what dishes they bring out!
I'll do my best with a fortune-boosting menu too!

text_block_list.name: MC Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's get started!
The theme of this showdown is... "Victory Fuel"!
To the kitchen, GO!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Victory fuel, huh...
Meaning—focusing on ingredients that provide power?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's see. Something that fills you with energy
just by eating it, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If we incorporate the proper feng shui principles
to align the qi... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
T-This is terrible!? The event refrigerator and... 
the microwave oven are placed right next to each other...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Microwave ovens are Fire! Refrigerators are Water!
The two have a conflicting, clashing elemental relationship...
They're supposed to be placed far apart!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But these are commercial-grade and wired in,
so moving them right now is impossible.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The colors of the utensils are bad too. The kitchen knife and cutting board,
the pot and ladle... They're all conflicting pairings...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
At this rate... if we start cooking like this,
we'll be at a huge disadvantage in terms of feng shui...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't panic.
That's not like you, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Here, eat this and calm down.
Keeping your composure is what counts, composure.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Like me... That's it! If the area's feng shui is unfavorable,
we just have to cook while avoiding all clashing conditions...!
It'll add extra steps, but—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I've got Tarumae and Acute-san with me.
If we combine our strengths, we can easily manage the cooking time...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Listen, both of you. Since this is our "Victory Meal," I want to do our best in terms of feng shui too.
That's why I really want to avoid any clashing elements.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Let's all think of ingredients and recipes we can whip up with these limited utensils!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho.
If you look closely, there are actually quite a few things we can use.
choice_data_list: You've been bustling around, did something go wrong?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine!
We hit a bit of a snag with the feng shui affinities, but we found a new way forward!
choice_data_list: Fight on! What matters is marching forward with confidence!
Fight on! What matters is never cutting corners!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah! All right, let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Now then, I suppose using plenty of Funabashi-grown spinach or komatsuna would be—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Toryaaah!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wh-What the heck is going on over there?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...She's prying open a massive pile of shellfish with her bare hands.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
Talk about doing things the hard and dynamic way.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Tackling this mountain of shells might have been pushing it a bit...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: But with this, we can cook without any clashing elemental clashes! Come on, let's keep the momentum going!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Our Victory Meal is...
the "Bounty of the Northern Seas Victory Curry"!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
We used plenty of seafood like Tomakomai's famous Sakhalin surf clams, along with Hokkaido mountain produce!
It even comes with haskap yogurt! ✨

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: In feng shui, the purple color of haskap berries gives you confidence, making it a perfect match for a Victory Meal!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... A whole parade of local ingredients, huh.
Guess our quick-and-easy time-saving recipe stands no chance against that.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes... It seems like it would go wonderfully with Funabashi spinach as well... I genuinely want to try some.

text_block_list.name: Judge Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Gah?! I see it...! I can clearly picture in my mind the powerful running of the horse girl who eats this...! My spoon just won't stop...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because it's a Victory Meal, we balanced the flow of qi using only harmonious cookware and matching ingredient colors.
It's a dish that makes you feel like you can't lose any showdown! ♪

text_block_list.name: MC Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
The winner is...
the "Bounty of the Northern Seas Victory Curry"!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yay! We did it!
I'm gonna refine this even more and ask them to put it on the menu here as Good Luck Curry! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That way, everyone's competitive luck will definitely shoot right up!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah! When you take the extra time and care, you can bring out the qi in the ingredients at its absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Something seriously wild is going on over there.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: All three of them are having an intense staring contest with the rice grains.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: The heck is that about? Did they run into some trouble and can't even cook properly anymore?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Well, since they said they were fine, I ain't holding back on 'em!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Our Victory Meal is...
the "Heartwarming Comfort ♪ One Soup, One Dish" meal!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hah! That's just completely plain ol' rice and miso soup! You really think you can beat us with somethin' like—

text_block_list.name: Judge Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
D-Delicious...!!
Without a shadow of a doubt, you win!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: What?! From just a single bite...?!

text_block_list.name: Judge Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Just plain rice...? Just plain miso soup...?
This is completely on a whole 'nother level from ordinary food...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Quit messin' around! Gimme a bite too! How on earth could that happen with just—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: SO FREAKIN' GOOOOOOD!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We were extremely thorough with our prep work!
We made sure every single rice grain was uniform in size so it would cook evenly!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Sorting grain sizes...?! Is THAT what Tran was talking about earlier?!
Just how much effort—no, I guess that's why it tastes this unreal.

text_block_list.name: Judge Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
So that's how you achieved such exquisite cooking throughout...
To pour this much sincere heart into tedious, painstaking labor... I am truly humbled. There is no finer Victory Meal than this.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Bringing happiness and putting smiles on faces... No matter what I do, that feeling is always my driving force!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Now that the contest is over, let's all dig in together! ♪ It's packed with positive yang energy, so it'll ward off bad spirits and bring nothing but good fortune!
